attempts.rationale: The issue occurs because `strtol` reads beyond the bounds of the allocated string when processing numeric primitives. Specifically, `strtol` may read past `str_end` when parsing integers due to lack of bounds checking before calling `strtol`. The fix adds an explicit null terminator within the bounds of the token's string slice so that `strtol` cannot overrun.
